item.title: Version 1.3.89
item.description:
- Redesigned the home screen: the whole app tints itself from your newest cover photo, a flowing topographic-line background echoes the website, and the header has a bold display title with live-site, gallery and draft chips.
- Publish is now a bright accent tile; the other actions sit in one row of quieter glass tiles.
- Gallery cards are photo-first: the cover fills the card with a bold title over it, status chips, and a hover zoom with a glow in that photo's own color.
